editorial:
Ever wondered how far someone would go for their favorite star? You get to see that play out with Simone, a girl who is completely obsessed with a famous pop singer. She doesn't just like his music; she thinks they are meant to be together. The vibe starts off as a typical story about a huge fan, but it quickly turns into something much scarier. When she finally gets close to him in a crowd and faints from excitement, you think it is just a cute moment. But once he tells her he does not love her, the movie shifts into a creepy nightmare that shows the dark side of hero-worship.

The acting is surprisingly good, especially the way Simone changes from a sweet girl to someone you are actually afraid of. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow until the big scares hit. If you like psychological thrillers, you will love this one. You should definitely try renting it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Simone completely losing her grip on reality. After being rejected, she decides that if she cannot have the singer, no one can. She breaks into his home for one last encounter. In a shocking twist, she attacks him in a violent rage, believing that death is the only way they can be together forever. The film closes with a grim scene showing that her love was actually a dangerous illness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about obsessed fans and psychological thrillers.
